summary: Destructive Creations' World War II isometric real-time tactics game set on the Eastern Front, later ported to consoles, Apple devices, and Switch.

entries.title: War Mongrels

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.

primary.why: Windows is the original and highest-fidelity route, with PC co-op support, flexible settings, and the most direct capture setup; console, Apple, and Switch ports add convenience but no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam/Epic or another legitimate PC storefront; use console or Apple ports only for comparison or portability.
